_README: Host profile for the AWS host: one Lambda MicroVM per worker run. The Manual runs this host's storage module only (hosting/aws-cdk/history.py); factory-setup/references/hosting-aws.md is the guide to the infrastructure, and factory-setup/references/aws-cdk/ a reference CDK app to copy. The image installs the bundle at paths.bundle. For a webhook notification channel, the run server writes the webhook from Secrets Manager to /tmp/factory/secrets/feed-webhook: set that as the channel's webhookFile under integrationOverrides.notifications. An env list must name AWS_CONFIG_FILE: every AWS call in a run goes through the config it points at.
name: aws-cdk
